# NetBox DNS

This mod adds the NetBox DNS plugin (PyPI: netbox-plugin-dns) to a netbox container.

Add it to the `netbox` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:netbox-dns
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:netbox-dns|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

Update your `configuration.py` to include the plugin

```
...
# Enable installed plugins. Add the name of each plugin to the list.
PLUGINS = ['netbox_dns']

...
```

On the next container start, the mod adds `netbox-plugin-dns` to the pip install list before NetBox runs its database migrations, and the plugin's tables will be created automatically.

## Removal

Before removing `DOCKER_MODS`, remove `'netbox_dns'` from the `PLUGINS` list in your `configuration.py`. Otherwise NetBox will fail to start because the plugin package will no longer be installed but is still referenced in the configuration.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/netbox-dns/
